goal: Bind every Nightshift generation to the deterministic non-secret Hermes harness state that actually ran, and enforce observable harness lineage before SEARCH-004 spends money.
changes: Fingerprint the Hermes runtime identity, Airlock model/profile, adapter command, redacted config, SOUL.md, skills, memories, hooks, tools, and context files when present.
Exclude .env, auth.json, secret-like credential files, databases, sessions, logs, caches, checkpoints, temporary state, and profile HOME from harness identity.
Record requested versus effective model per attempt; effective model comes only from post-execution worker evidence and remains explicitly UNAVAILABLE when not observed.
Bind requested model routing and a deterministic tool-registry digest into the pre-spend harness fingerprint.
Capture a controller-owned harness set immediately before each Nightshift tournament and again after the worker returns.
Record the starting harness and every observed A-to-B transition inside signed generation receipts.
Map each model/profile attempt to its pre-spend worker fingerprint.
Refuse the next tournament before spend if the observed pre-run harness no longer descends from the prior controller-observed state.
Keep HERMES-LIVE-001 frozen files byte-identical, including src/airlock/runner.py.
invariants: Capability may mutate its harness; it still cannot mutate the repo-owned evaluator or promotion rule.
Harness identity never depends on credential values or transient session/cache churn.
Every paid Nightshift generation has an observable pre-spend harness identity.
A later generation may inherit only the harness state the controller observed at the end of the prior generation window.
Unobserved harness drift between generations fails before the next tournament spends.
Repository-local Hermes instructions remain part of repo state rather than being double-counted as external harness state.
Requested model identity never substitutes for observed effective-model evidence.
Tool-registry changes create a new harness identity even when the model and profile name stay constant.
claim_boundary: The receipt proves deterministic non-secret harness identity and controller-observed lineage across Nightshift generation windows. It does not prove that Hermes alone caused every mutable-state change inside a window, does not persist credentials or session transcripts, and does not establish that the chosen fingerprint surface captures every future Hermes capability input. Hermes-first only; this is not a generic harness protocol.
search_004_rule: Autonomous and maintainer-guided Hermes arms must both record starting harness fingerprints, requested routing, tool-registry identity, all observed transitions, and effective-model evidence when exposed. Different starting fingerprints are a confound unless the preregistration explicitly makes harness choice an experimental variable; unavailable effective-model evidence remains an explicit attribution limitation.
